Medal of the Campaign Home Europe Asia America Africa Oceania Links Back Tags list Allies Research Back Societies Forums Back All updates Album sheets Reference Catalogue Search Medal of the Campaign Medal instituted by Emperor Haile Selassie I on 30th November 1944. Medal awarded to patriots for meritorious military service against the enemy during the Campaign 1936-1941. Medal have single class. Torches added to medal ribbon for each year of service.
